ELITE: NEXT 2.5.153 - YOUR SELECTED MISSION, YOUR NEXT STEP

WORK > MISSION LOG: highlight a mission, then X to track it.
SELECT tracks the highlighted mission and opens its next-step details.
WORK > TRACKED MISSION always follows that selection.

Explorers Guild lives in Mission Log, not a separate Work menu.
Station Welcome is an optional log selection, never an automatic override.
The old optional flight guide is retired. START TUTORIAL remains available.

First Flight explains launch, steering, target selection, flight distance,
docking and rewards in full dialogue. Orange reply boxes remain.
Approach the station and press CIRCLE within 2,500 m to request docking.
There is no separate docking-guidance menu step in the story.

Kei's later briefings have clearer prose and mission steps update with progress.
Tutorial Guild instructions now use Mission Log; exercise timing is unchanged.
No save migration is required. Physical PSP testing remains outstanding.
